Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Ct Mason Has Trimmed Holding in Apple (AAPL) by $4.75 Million; As Nxp Semiconductors Nv (NXPI) Stock Price Declined, Shareholder Armstrong Shaw Associates Cut Its Holding by $564,993
June 6, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Ct Mason decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 44.84% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ct Mason sold 28,461 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 35,008 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.87M, down from 63,469 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ct Mason who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $950.15B market cap company. The stock increased 0.77% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $193.31. About 19.54M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% 9.99% the S&P500. Armstrong Shaw Associates Inc decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors Nv (NXPI) by 18.02% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Armstrong Shaw Associates Inc sold 4,829 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,972 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.57 million, down from 26,801 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Armstrong Shaw Associates Inc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors Nv for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $40.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 5.11% or $5.66 during the last trading session, reaching $116.36. About 4.73M shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 8.19% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.38% the S&P500.
